reviewWorktreeWarning: Warning: review comments are stored inside this linked Git worktree and are deleted with it by git worktree remove or git clean -fdX.
adviceLanguageOption: --lang requires en or fr, supplied once.
expectedCommand: Expected the export, init, inspect, edit, comments, studio, recovery, identity or narration command.

studio.portFallback: The default Studio port is unavailable. Another Studio may already be serving this course. Studio is using a temporary port for this session.
studio.reviewCourseRequired: --review requires a regular {filename} file in the course folder. No review storage was created.
studio.reviewHelp: Enable local review comments in Read mode for this session
studio.reviewAssetsMissing: Review asset unavailable: {filename}. Rebuild the standalone CLI. Studio did not start.
studio.reviewRefused: Review storage refused: {code} at {path}. Studio did not start.
studio.reviewPortFallback: The preferred learner port is unavailable. Earlier drafts may be unavailable, and new drafts may not survive a restart.

recovery.restoreHeld: Archive kept. Delete it with praxity recovery resolve when you no longer need it.
recovery.restoreSide: Choose original or replacement for recovery restore.
recovery.restoreJournal: Recovery archive has no valid journal. No files were changed.
recovery.restoreCopy: Recovery archive has no selected file copy. No files were changed.
recovery.draftsSkippedNotice: Some retained draft files could not be read in .praxity/local/drafts/. Run praxity recovery list for file names and reasons.
recovery.draftsNotice: {count, plural, one {# retained draft} other {# retained drafts}}. Export with {command}.

edit.renderedUsage: For rendered IDs from inspect --text-fields, use setText --at <rendered-node-id> --rendered --expect-revision <sha256>. Without --rendered, overlapping IDs select the source UUID; rendered-only IDs still require a revision.
edit.cleanup: Changes committed. Journal cleanup is pending.
edit.stale: The expected revision is stale. Inspect the course again.
edit.conflict: The selected source changed. Inspect the course again.
edit.ambiguous: Several nodes match. Use an address or UUID from inspect --blocks.
edit.pageAmbiguous: Page selector {page} matches {count} pages: {candidates}. Use one of these with --page.
edit.pagePath: Use a .prax lesson path relative to the course root, without traversal, absolute paths, backslashes or colons.
edit.pageNumber: Use a positive whole page number after the lesson path and colon.
edit.lessonMissing: Lesson "{file}" was not found in the course.
edit.pageMissing: Page {page} was not found in lesson "{file}".
edit.orphaned: The selected node was not found.
edit.escapes-range: The edit would change source outside the selected node.
edit.not-allowed: This operation or target is unavailable. Batches are not supported yet.
edit.invalid-args: Invalid edit arguments. Use praxity edit --help.
edit.line-break: Keep the heading on one line.
edit.list-marker: This line would become a list item. Remove the list marker to keep it as text.
edit.settings: Braces would become heading settings. Remove the braces to keep this as text.
edit.source-invalid: Fix the source errors in the selected lesson before editing.
edit.bad-yaml: Fix the YAML frontmatter in the selected lesson before editing.
edit.identity-retirement-pending: The course has unrecorded content removals. Run praxity identity init to review them.
edit.failed: The operation failed. No successful edit was acknowledged.

identityMerge.help: Merge content identities after resolving the .prax sources. Exit 3 means identity conflicts.
identityMerge.notMerging: No git merge is in progress. Start a merge before merging content identities.
identityMerge.multipleHeads: Several merge heads are present. Merge one branch at a time.
identityMerge.sourceConflicts: Resolve the merge conflict markers in the .prax sources before merging content identities.
identityMerge.outsideRepository: The course is outside the git repository.
identityMerge.success: Content identities merged. Git's index is unchanged. Review and stage the identity files to finish the merge.
identityMerge.divergent-change: Both branches changed the same entity.
identityMerge.retired-id: A branch reused a retired UUID.
identityMerge.documents-mismatch: The merged sources do not match the branch identities.

narration.usage: Use narration status, accept or attach with a node UUID and role.

init.help: Hide .praxity and recovery copies when you open the course folder in VS Code. Keep .praxity versioned in Git. Respect existing workspace values. Init cannot read User settings reliably. To let a User-level false take effect, set the workspace entry to false or remove it. .gitignore is never changed.
init.noGit: Not a Git work tree; skipped Git exclusions.
init.preserved: Left .gitignore and recovery copies unchanged. Init does not exclude .praxity from Git.
init.invalidSettings: Invalid or ambiguous settings in .vscode/settings.json. Settings and Git exclusions were left unchanged.
init.failed: Initialization failed. Check the course path, settings and Git metadata.
init.hidden: {name} hidden in VS Code files and search.
init.already: {name} already hidden in VS Code files and search.
init.authorChoice: Left {name} as the author set it in VS Code.
init.workspace: For VS Code hiding to apply, open the course folder as the workspace folder.
init.userSettings: Init cannot read User settings reliably. To let a User-level false take effect, set the workspace entry to false or remove it. Init never changes User settings.
init.unhide: To unhide an entry, set it to false or remove it from .vscode/settings.json. Init preserves matching false patterns on reruns.
init.notWritable: Left {target} unchanged: not writable. Initialization stopped without changing its permissions.
init.targetFailed: Could not update {target}. That file was left unchanged. Check its permissions, path and Git metadata.

comments.usage:
praxity comments list <course> [--status open|resolved] [--page <pageId>] [--json] [--lang en|fr]
praxity comments reply <course> <threadId> --text-file <path> --expect-version <n> --request-id <uuid> [--json] [--lang en|fr]
praxity comments resolve <course> <threadId> --reply-file <path> --expect-version <n> --request-id <uuid> [--json] [--lang en|fr]
praxity comments reopen <course> <threadId> --expect-version <n> --request-id <uuid> [--json] [--lang en|fr]
comments.replayed: Request replayed. The original outcome is unchanged.
comments.hiddenThread: The operation was acknowledged. This thread is no longer visible.
comments.cleanupPending: The operation was acknowledged. Storage cleanup is pending.
comments.failed: The comment operation failed. No successful outcome was acknowledged.
comments.invalid-args: Invalid comments arguments. Use praxity comments --help.
comments.invalidFlag: Invalid comments argument: {flag}. Use praxity comments --help.
comments.unfinishedInit: Open the course in Studio with review enabled to finish setup, then retry.
comments.stale_version: New feedback changed the thread. List comments again before acting.
comments.not_found: Thread not found in this review.
comments.forbidden: This principal cannot perform the operation.
comments.request_id_reused: This request ID was already used with different input.
comments.wrong_review: The request belongs to a different review.
comments.snapshot_changed: The review kept changing. List comments again.
comments.limit_reached: The review has reached a storage or activity limit. No changes were saved.
comments.text-file-missing: The message file does not exist.
comments.text-file-unreadable: The message file cannot be read as a regular file.
comments.invalid-utf8: The message file must contain valid UTF-8.
comments.whitespace-only: The message file contains only whitespace.
comments.text-too-large: The message exceeds the review body length limit of {limit} UTF-16 units.
comments.lone-surrogate: The message contains a surrogate encoding that UTF-8 cannot represent.
comments.list-too-large: The complete list exceeds the {limit} UTF-8 byte limit. A single thread may exceed this limit.
comments.corrupt-json: Review storage contains corrupt JSON. Preserve the files for recovery.
comments.invalid-state: Review storage is invalid. Preserve the files for recovery.
comments.newer-schema: This review requires a newer version of Studio.
comments.unsafe-path: Review storage has an unsafe path. Use a plain local copy.
comments.disk-error: A disk error prevented acknowledgement. Preserve the request ID before checking storage.
comments.interrupted-write: Storage admission or persistence was interrupted. Preserve the request ID and check storage before retrying.
comments.tracked-storage: Review storage is tracked by Git. Remove it from the index before proceeding.
comments.not-initialized: This course has no local review. Start Studio with review enabled first.
comments.busy: Review storage is busy. Keep the request ID and retry after the other operation finishes.
comments.recovery-required: Review storage needs recovery. Preserve the files and recover the course before retrying.
comments.git-unavailable: Git cannot verify that review storage is private. Restore Git access before retrying.
comments.filesystem-unsupported: This filesystem cannot provide the guarantees required by review storage. Use a supported local filesystem.
comments.course-not-found: The course path does not exist.
comments.course-not-directory: The course path must name a directory.
comments.course-manifest-missing: The course directory must contain a regular course.yaml file.
comments.course-manifest-not-file: The course.yaml entry must be a regular file.

identityInit.rederiveWarning: Re-deriving gives blocks new IDs. Learner records from any earlier published version will not map to the new blocks. Proceed with --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.rederiveRequired: Identity initialization refused: existing blocks could not be matched. Run praxity identity init {course} --rederive --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.exportRederiveAdvice: Existing blocks could not be matched. Run praxity identity init {course} --rederive --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.help: Record page and block identity for a hand-written course without changing its source. Reruns leave current identity unchanged.
identityInit.initialized: Recorded course identity in .praxity/identity/. Source files unchanged.
identityInit.unchanged: Course identity is already current. No files changed.
identityInit.sourceError: Identity initialization refused: {file}:{line} contains a source error. Fix the source, then run praxity identity init {course}.
identityInit.exportSourceError: Export refused: {file}:{line} contains a source error. Fix it, run praxity identity init {course}, then export again.
identityInit.pendingError: Identity initialization refused: {file}:{line} repeats a block that already has an ID, so Praxity can't tell which copy keeps it. Change or remove the extra copy, then run praxity identity init {course}. The copy with the unchanged text keeps the original ID.
identityInit.sameTitlePages: Identity initialization refused: {file}:{line} is a page with the same title as another page, so Praxity can't tell which page keeps which ID. To keep the page IDs, move the page back to where it was, then run praxity identity init {course}. Only if this course has never been published, you can instead run praxity identity init {course} --rederive --confirm-unpublished; those pages then get new IDs.
identityInit.exportSameTitlePages: Export refused: {file}:{line} is a page with the same title as another page, so Praxity can't tell which page keeps which ID. To keep the page IDs, move the page back to where it was, run praxity identity init {course}, then export again. Only if this course has never been published, you can instead run praxity identity init {course} --rederive --confirm-unpublished; those pages then get new IDs.
identityInit.exportPendingAdvice: Export refused: {file}:{line} repeats a block that already has an ID. Change or remove the extra copy, run praxity identity init {course}, then export again.
identityInit.copyCountDropped: Identity initialization refused: {file}:{line}: several saved blocks had this text and fewer copies remain, so Praxity can't tell which you removed. Restore the removed copy, then run praxity identity init {course}. If this course has never been published, you can instead run it with --rederive --confirm-unpublished; these blocks then get new IDs.
identityInit.exportCopyCountDropped: Export refused: {file}:{line}: several saved blocks had this text and fewer copies remain, so Praxity can't tell which you removed. Restore the removed copy, run praxity identity init {course}, then export again. If this course has never been published, you can instead run it with --rederive --confirm-unpublished; these blocks then get new IDs.
identityInit.exportAdvice: Run praxity identity init {course} to record page and block identity, then export again. Resolve any reported source or identity errors first.
identityInit.exportRefused: Export refused: course identity must be recorded or reviewed before export.
identityInit.recoveryRequired: Project recovery required. Reopen the course in Studio or run praxity recovery run "<project-dir>" with this course folder to recover the interrupted transaction, then retry the command. Read-only access leaves every file unchanged.
identityInit.deletionWarning: Removed blocks retire their IDs; learner records for them stop mapping. Proceed with --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.deletionRequired: Identity initialization refused: removed blocks retire their IDs; learner records for them stop mapping. Run praxity identity init {course} --rederive --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.exportDeletionAdvice: Removed blocks retire their IDs; learner records for them stop mapping. Run praxity identity init {course} --rederive --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.retiredHeading: IDs being retired. Learner records for these identities stop mapping:
identityInit.mixedRederiveRequired: Identity initialization refused: {file}:{line} repeats existing text. Make it unique, then run praxity identity init {course}. If other changes remain, run it with --rederive --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
identityInit.exportMixedRederiveAdvice: Export refused: {file}:{line} repeats existing text. Make it unique, then run praxity identity init {course}. If other changes remain, run it with --rederive --confirm-unpublished only if this course has never been published.
